fact: The Bank of Ghana has started testing interoperability of CBDCs, stablecoins, bank accounts and mobile wallets with Rwanda and Nigeria, per Governor Asiama.
Ghana News Agency reports the Bank of Ghana saying it is piloting cross-border interoperability with CBDCs, stablecoins, bank accounts and mobile wallets in the Ghana-Rwanda corridor.

Bank of Kigali, per its own announcement reported by KT Press, became a direct participant in China's CIPS under an agreement signed 2026-09-08, giving direct renminbi clearing and settlement for Rwanda-China payments without several intermediary banks.

Rwanda and Tanzania are advancing a cross-border Instant Payment System proof of concept, with a technical mission in Kigali under the EU-EAC DEEP Programme working toward a joint roadmap, per techreviewafrica.
